description: This file defines the interface and constants for the CJ125 sensor in a hardware layer, including register configurations, diagnostic register definitions, and function declarations related to the CJ125 sensor's operation and measurements.

methods.name: initCJ125
methods.description: Initializes the CJ125 sensor with shared logging and engine parameters.

methods.name: cjGetAfr
methods.description: Returns the current AFR measurement from the CJ125 sensor.

methods.name: cjHasAfrSensor
methods.description: Checks if the CJ125 sensor is present and functioning.

methods.name: cj125defaultPinout
methods.description: Configures the default pinout connections for the CJ125 sensor.
